how many feet in a meter | meters to feet | how many feet is a meter => One meter is about 3.28 feet, or about 39.37 inches. Multiply meters by 3.28 to get feet.

how many quarts in a liter | liters to quarts | is a liter bigger than a quart => One liter is about 1.057 US quarts, so a liter is a little bigger than a quart.
how many milliliters in a teaspoon | teaspoon in ml | how many ml is a teaspoon => A US teaspoon is about 4.93 milliliters, usually rounded to 5 mL. A tablespoon is about 15 mL.
how many milliliters in a cup | cup in ml | how many ml is a cup => A US cup is about 237 milliliters, often rounded to 240 mL. A metric cup, used in some countries, is 250 mL.
how many acres in a hectare | hectares to acres | is a hectare bigger than an acre => One hectare is about 2.47 acres, so a hectare is bigger. A hectare is 10,000 square meters.
